🇫🇷 PhD in Privacy-Preserving Speech Understanding

Location: France
Hiring Organization: LORIA Inria

The LORIA/Inria is offering a fully funded 3-year PhD position in Privacy-Preserving Speech Understanding with Multimodal Signals for Clinical Applications in France.
Base Salary: €2,300 gross/month

The LORIA/Inria is offering a fully funded 3-year PhD position in Privacy-Preserving Speech Understanding with Multimodal Signals for Clinical Applications. The project aims to protect speaker identity and other sensitive information while retaining what's needed for clinical speech understanding.

Topics of research include voice anonymization and spoken-content de-identification, speech/audio large language models, clinical spoken language understanding, multimodal learning (speech, text, and additional signals), privacy-utility trade-off evaluation, and trustworthy AI.

The position is funded by the AI Grand Est ENACT Cluster research chair and offers a salary of €2,300 gross/month. The expected start date is October or November 2026.

To apply, please visit the application website (https://t.co/FmQcToJB92) or contact natalia.tomashenko@inria.fr for more information.

#PhDposition #multimodalsignals #clinicalapplications
chinese_translation: 法国LORIA/Inria提供全额资助3年博士职位，研究方向为保护隐私的语音理解与多模态信号在临床应用中的应用。月薪2300欧元毛。研究主题包括语音匿名化、口语内容去识别、语音/音频大语言模型、临床口语语言理解、多模态学习、隐私-效用权衡评估和可信AI。预计开始时间为2026年10月或11月。申请请访问网站或联系natalia.tomashenko@inria.fr。
research_focus: Privacy-preserving speech understanding with multimodal signals for clinical applications
application_notes: Fully funded 3 years, salary €2,300 gross/month, start Oct/Nov 2026. Contact natalia.tomashenko@inria.fr or application website.
